exceptions.rationale: json 2.18.0 is a default gem of Homebrew 7.0.12's portable Ruby 4.0.9, and Homebrew main ships the same portable Ruby. GHSA-3m6g-2423-7cp3 applies only when a caller parses with `allow_duplicate_key: false`; Homebrew 7.0.12 passes only `allow_duplicate_key: true` (livecheck/strategy/json.rb). Remove this entry when Homebrew bumps portable Ruby to a release with json 2.19.2 or later.
compensatingControls: Homebrew and its portable Ruby run as the unprivileged sandbox user inside the OpenShell Landlock and network policy.
